spec.description: One row per strategy. Trading PnL = Total PnL − Positional PnL, where Positional PnL = qty_at(start) × (mid_at(end) − mid_at(start)). Total PnL is computed per (strategy, mimid_start_time) session and summed, making it immune to mid-session resets. Mid uses bid as proxy. FUNDING (PnL-impact sign: negative = funding PAID, positive = received; consistent with the PnL columns). fundingUsd (StrategyFees) is a per-session cumulative COST counter (positive = paid on the exchange side), so it is negated here. FH1-3 = difference(last(fundingUsd)) per 30m bucket = per-event funding increments (3-way strategy-prefix split to stay under InfluxDB max-select-point). PH1-3 = last(positionAsFloat) per 30m bucket fill(previous) = position near that event. Merge pairs rows on Time+strategy; events with |qty_at_event| <= 1 are excluded (near-zero positions produce garbage rates; their tiny funding lands in dayT). event_rate = funding_event / qty_at_event; rate_sum = sum per strategy. funding_total = -SUM(funding_event) over the SAME events (not edge slivers). funding_dayP = -(rate_sum × qty_open) = funding of the opening position at each event's rate; funding_dayT = funding_total − funding_dayP = funding from position changes. dayP + dayT == total exactly. CAVEAT: NOT reset-immune — fundingUsd resets to ~0 on strategy restart; a reset inside the window biases funding_total, and difference() drops the first bucket, so prefer short windows (<= ~6h). Footer = totals across selected strategies.
